explication: MCP Gateway accepts agent MCP traffic, validates gateway/server configuration, and serves routed or unified MCP sessions. Requests are authenticated, mapped to tools or GitHub proxy routes, evaluated through DIFC/guard policy, then dispatched to configured MCP backends or GitHub and returned after response filtering. Supporting branches provide container launching, delegation control, session state, TLS/HMAC, health/shutdown endpoints, logging, and tracing. The graph reflects README capabilities and sampled source; several startup and unified-server links are necessarily summarized at directory-level paths.
